name: The Bible in One Year — default plan
description: Starter reading plan. Expand with full WEBUS chapter blocks per day as production continues.

days.listeningFocus: notice how God brings order, life, and rest into creation
days.reflectionMainThought: God creates with purpose and invites humanity into relationship.
days.reflectionApplication: Where do you need to trust that God is bringing order into something that feels unfinished?
prayerPoints: ask for trust in His design
ask for rest in His presence

days.listeningFocus: notice how sin breaks trust, yet God still pursues His people
days.reflectionMainThought: Sin separates, but God still calls people back to Himself.
days.reflectionApplication: Where might you need to return to God with honesty instead of hiding?
prayerPoints: ask for mercy to walk with God again

days.listeningFocus: notice God's patience and judgment working together
days.reflectionMainThought: God is patient, yet He will not ignore evil forever.
days.reflectionApplication: What small compromise might you be tolerating that needs honest attention?
prayerPoints: ask for courage to turn from compromise
ask for faith to follow His way
